content.title: Stellantis Appoints Joao Laranjo CFO as Doug Ostermann Resigns
content.summary: Stellantis  appointed Joao Laranjo as its new chief financial officer, succeeding  Doug Ostermann,  who has resigned for personal reasons, the company said Monday.  The Jeep-maker said Laranjo’s appointment is effective immediately.  Laranjo joined Fiat Chrysler Automobiles—the automotive group formed by the merger of Fiat and Chrysler—in 2009 as chief accounting officer for Latin America, rising to chief financial officer for the region.

content.title: 3 Russell 2000 Stocks That Fall Short
content.summary: The Russell 2000 (^RUT) is home to many small-cap stocks, offering investors the chance to uncover hidden gems before the broader market catches on. However, these companies often come with higher volatility and risk, as their smaller size makes them more vulnerable to economic downturns.
